evidence: We have used XPS and UPS to study the reaction of TMGa on the As-rich c(2 X 8) GaAs( 100) surface... XPS spectra were usually taken with 80° exit angle to improve the surface sensitivity... The adsorption of TMGa on the As-rich GaAs(100) surface depends strongly on the sample temperature... We have used UPS to investigate the adsorption state of the TMGa molecule... The samples were cleaned by cycles of ion sputtering and thermal annealing at 730°C in 4 X 10-5 Torr of AsH3 to obtain the c(2 X 8) As-rich surface as monitored in situ with low-energy electron diffraction (LEED).
